bB1.prompt: Morning in a tropical colonial bedroom. Striped honey-gold light falls through half-open wooden shutters across a white bed. The woman from the reference image (same face, grey-green eyes, dark hair, the faint pale scar through her left eyebrow) lies on her side with her back half to the camera, her face in profile on the pillow, eyes open, lips parted; a white sheet clings damply to her body up to the shoulder blades; bare shoulders and the line of her spine, damp skin with pores and a sheen of sweat; one honey stripe of light lies across her shoulder; a wet white plumeria blossom on the pillow by her hair. Still, intimate, adult, not explicit.

bB2.prompt: Night during a tropical storm in a dark colonial room. The woman from the first reference image (same face, grey-green eyes, dark hair pinned up, the faint pale scar through her left eyebrow) and the man from the second reference image (same face, tanned, light ash-blond hair with silver at the temples, golden stubble, pale blue eyes, about 47, beautiful) sit facing each other very close across a small round wooden table. The shadows of wooden shutter slats fall across both of them like the bars of a cage. She holds a just-struck match close to her own open, unblinking eyes; its flame is the only warm light; cold blue lightning-light from the window behind. She wears a sheer green jungle-print silk dress; he wears an open white linen shirt. They stare at each other without blinking. Tension, desire held back.
